### Why book group flights with Airlines Group Travel?

Booking ten or more seats is different from booking one. Airlines release limited group inventory with its own rules. We handle that for you.

### Group flight FAQs

**Q: How many passengers count as a group booking?**

Most airlines treat 10 or more passengers travelling together on the same itinerary as a group. If your party is smaller, call us anyway — we can often still find fares that keep everyone together.

**Q: How do I get a group flight quote?**

Call +1-888-609-1015 (24/7) or send the quote form with your route, dates, number of travelers and cabin class. A group travel specialist compares options across airlines and gets back to you with a quote.

**Q: Is a group fare cheaper than booking individual tickets?**

Often, yes. Group fares can be lower than the public fares for the same seats, and they usually come with added flexibility such as a small deposit, later name submission and a single locked-in fare for the whole group. Savings depend on the airline, route and travel dates.

**Q: Do I need all passenger names when I book?**

Usually not. Many airline group contracts let you hold seats with a deposit and submit final passenger names closer to departure. Name deadlines vary by airline and are confirmed in your quote.

**Q: Can I book now and pay later?**

Many group contracts need only a deposit to hold the seats, with the balance due before ticketing. Your specialist explains the deposit and payment schedule for your group before you commit.

## Group flight booking services

URL: https://airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page/group-flights/

### What is a group flight booking?

A group booking reserves seats for 10 or more passengers travelling together on the same flights. Airlines price and manage these bookings separately from individual tickets. Group bookings usually include a negotiated fare, a deposit to hold the seats, and a later deadline for passenger names and final payment.

### What's included when you book with us
- Group fare comparisons across multiple airlines and routings
- Economy, premium economy, business and first-class quotes
- Round-trip, one-way and multi-city itineraries
- Groups departing from several cities and meeting at one destination
- Help with deposit schedules, name lists and ticketing deadlines
- Seating requests, special assistance and schedule-change support

### Group types we specialize in

### Sports teams
Tournament and league travel for teams, coaches and supporters, with dates matched to your fixtures.

### Weddings & family events
Destination weddings, reunions and milestone celebrations, keeping the whole family on one itinerary.

### Corporate & conferences
Meetings, incentives, trade shows and offsites, with name-change flexibility for busy teams.

### Schools & students
Class trips, study abroad, choirs and bands, with chaperone-friendly seating and deposit plans.

### Religious & mission trips
Pilgrimages, church groups and mission teams travelling to one destination together.

### Tours & leisure groups
Tour operators, clubs and friends travelling together on domestic or international holidays.

### Tips for a smooth group booking
- Book early. Airlines limit how many group seats they sell on each flight. Aim for 3 to 11 months ahead.
- Be flexible where you can. Moving your dates by a day, or choosing a nearby airport, can lower the group fare a lot.
- Know your headcount range. Give us a minimum and maximum. Many contracts allow some attrition before a deadline.
- Collect names early. Names must match government ID exactly, so start collecting them early.

## About Airlines Group Travel

URL: https://airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page/about/

### Group travel is all we do

Airlines Group Travel started in 2022 to make group air travel simpler. Coordinating flights for a team, a wedding party or a company is complicated: limited seats, name deadlines, deposits and many travelers to keep informed. Our group travel specialists handle those details so organizers can focus on the trip itself.

We are a US travel agency operated by Airfare Services USA LLC and based in Dover, Delaware. We book group airfare on most major domestic and international airlines, in every cabin class.

### What we stand for
- Clear quotes. We explain fares, deposits, name deadlines and change rules before you commit.

## Group flight booking FAQ

URL: https://airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page/faq/

**Q: How many passengers count as a group booking?**

Most airlines treat 10 or more passengers travelling together on the same itinerary as a group. If your party is smaller, call us anyway — we can often still find fares that keep everyone together.

**Q: How do I get a group flight quote?**

Call +1-888-609-1015 (24/7) or send the quote form with your route, dates, number of travelers and cabin class. A group travel specialist compares options across airlines and gets back to you with a quote.

**Q: Is a group fare cheaper than booking individual tickets?**

Often, yes. Group fares can be lower than the public fares for the same seats, and they usually come with added flexibility such as a small deposit, later name submission and a single locked-in fare for the whole group. Savings depend on the airline, route and travel dates.

**Q: Do I need all passenger names when I book?**

Usually not. Many airline group contracts let you hold seats with a deposit and submit final passenger names closer to departure. Name deadlines vary by airline and are confirmed in your quote.

**Q: Can I book now and pay later?**

Many group contracts need only a deposit to hold the seats, with the balance due before ticketing. Your specialist explains the deposit and payment schedule for your group before you commit.

**Q: Which airlines can you book for groups?**

We can book group travel on most major US and international airlines, including American, Delta, United, Southwest, Alaska, JetBlue, Lufthansa, British Airways, Emirates and Qatar Airways. We are an independent agency and not affiliated with any airline.

**Q: Can you book business class or first class for groups?**

Yes. We quote economy, premium economy, business and first class for groups, and can mix cabins within one group when needed.

**Q: How far in advance should we book group flights?**

As early as possible — ideally 3 to 11 months before departure. Group seat inventory is limited per flight, and booking early gives you the best choice of fares and schedules.

**Q: Can passengers travel from different cities?**

Yes. We can coordinate groups flying from several departure cities so that everyone arrives at the destination together.

**Q: Is Airlines Group Travel an airline?**

No. Airlines Group Travel is an independent travel agency run by Airfare Services USA LLC in Dover, Delaware. Our main website is www.airlinesgrouptravel.com.

Still have a question? Call +1-888-609-1015 or email info@airlinesgrouptravel.com.

## Privacy Policy

URL: https://airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page/privacy-policy/

Last updated: 2026-09-30

This Privacy Policy explains how Airfare Services USA LLC ("Airlines Group Travel", "we", "us") collects and uses information on airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page.

### Information we collect
- Quote requests: your name, email, phone number, travel details and any message you send through our forms.
- Communications: records of calls and emails with our specialists.
- Technical data: the page you submitted a form from. This site uses no advertising cookies.

### How we use it
- To prepare and send group travel quotes and to contact you about your request.
- To make bookings you ask for, which means sharing passenger details with airlines and travel suppliers.
- To meet legal, accounting and fraud-prevention obligations.

### Sharing

We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with airlines and suppliers needed for your booking, with service providers who store data for us (for example, Google Workspace), or when the law requires it.

### Retention

We keep quote requests for as long as we need them to serve you and meet legal obligations, then delete them.

### Your choices

You can ask to see, correct or delete your information, or opt out of follow-up contact, by emailing info@airlinesgrouptravel.com. California residents may have extra rights under the CCPA/CPRA.

### Hosting

This website is hosted on Codeberg Pages. Codeberg may process server logs such as IP addresses to operate the service.

### Contact

Airfare Services USA LLC, 8 The Green, Suite A, Dover, DE 19901, USA · +1-888-609-1015

## Terms & Conditions

URL: https://airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page/terms/

Last updated: 2026-09-30

These terms govern your use of airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page, operated by Airfare Services USA LLC ("Airlines Group Travel").

### Our role

Airlines Group Travel is an independent travel agency. We are not an airline. Air transportation is provided by the airline shown on your ticket, under that airline's conditions of carriage.

### Quotes and fares

Quotes are estimates based on availability at the time they are given. Fares, taxes and seat availability are not guaranteed until the airline confirms the booking and tickets are issued.

### Deposits, names and payments

Group bookings follow the deposit, name-submission, payment and cancellation rules of the airline's group contract. We tell you these rules in writing before you confirm. Missing a deadline can mean losing seats or deposits.

### Changes and cancellations

Changes and cancellations follow airline rules and may cost extra fees. Our service fees, if any, are disclosed before booking. See the refund policy on our main website for details.

### Travel documents

Each traveler is responsible for valid passports, visas and health documents, and for making sure names match government ID.

### Website content

Information on this site is general and may change. Airline names and trademarks belong to their owners and are used only for identification.

### Limitation of liability

To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for airline schedule changes, cancellations, delays or other acts of suppliers outside our control.

### Contact

Questions? Call +1-888-609-1015 or email info@airlinesgrouptravel.com.

## How Can I Book a Group Flight on Ethiopian Airlines?

URL: https://airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page/blog/how-can-i-book-a-group-flight-on-ethiopian-airlines/
Published: 2026-09-29

Passengers can embark on an enhanced escape with Ethiopian Airlines. This airline is known to offer a wide range of services on its distinct routes. Moreover, travelers can plan a solo or collective trip with these travel features. In such cases, flyers offer special group travel services for those passengers who prefer traveling together. But to get Ethiopian Airlines group travel tickets, there are requirements for travelers seeking to complete their journey together. Before planning the trip, one must consider those factors. By doing so, accessing the airline's exclusive travel facilities and special fares makes air travel easier. Besides, the information that is required to arrange shared voyages is as follows.

### What Is the Group Booking Policy on Ethiopian Airlines?
Travelers seeking to fly together with their companions can take an Ethiopian Airlines flight. Since such travel includes several passengers, the airline follows certain conditions to keep the reservation properly structured. The Ethiopian Airlines group booking policy makes the reservation process smoother by letting passengers know every requirement of flying together. Also, taking a quick look at them beforehand can avoid confusion during the booking or later on. The important points related to these policies are mentioned below.
- The airline allows more than 9 companions to fly in a group to the same destination, and they have to fly through one or more flight segments under the same reservation.
- A single reservation can include up to 99 flyers. But seats can be pre-reserved for only 50 passengers at a time. If the itinerary has all 99 members, two PNRs have to be created for issuing the seats.
- Names need to be submitted 60 days before departure. If a traveler cannot provide the name by that date, the name may be submitted 30 days before takeoff.
- A group itinerary may also be cancelled by the traveler when the option is mentioned in the airline's offer.
- The reservation may no longer qualify as group travel when the cancellation reduces the party size to 9 flyers or fewer.

### How Can I Book a Group Flight on Ethiopian Airlines?
Ethiopian Airlines provides travelers with a dedicated way to put forward an inquiry for group travel on the basis of their proposed itinerary. This airline lets eligible passengers visit its official website and submit the required information to initiate the request. The Ethiopian Airlines group flight booking request can then be reviewed by the concerned team, after which a quotation may be shared according to the travel requirements. The complete method for submitting the group travel request is outlined in the steps below.
- Head to the group portal of Ethiopian Airlines.
- New users can create an account, while registered users can sign in directly.
- Afterward, find the group travel option and access the form.
- Enter the required information in the form and send the request.
- The airline will check the request and return a quotation for the trip.
- Go through the offer and accept it before the stated expiry time.
- Then, pay the initial deposit first, followed by the remaining amount as instructed.
- Once the payment is done, add the names of all passengers within the given deadline.
- After the final details are received, the group itinerary or tickets will arrive by email.

###

### Does Ethiopian Airlines Offer Group Discounts?
Indeed! Travelers can acquire group discounts on Ethiopian Airlines. But for that, they have to fly with multiple individuals. Basically, these discounts apply to the Ethiopian Airlines group booking, which is made for 10 or more familiar flyers. Not only special fares, but the airline also offers groups flexible name changes and submission options. Also, flyers might be able to secure their reservation with a small deposit.

###

### Conclusion
Thus, planning a shared journey with Ethiopian Airlines becomes easier once the essential group travel aspects are understood. The applicable requirements, booking provisions and related formalities give travelers a better understanding of how their journey can be taken forward. By going through the Ethiopian Airlines group ticket booking details discussed above, one can prepare their plans with greater clarity and keep the necessary arrangements in order. This also makes it easier to handle the reservation without unnecessary confusion along the way.

## How Can I Book a Group Flight with Alaska Airlines?

URL: https://airlinesgrouptravel.codeberg.page/blog/how-can-i-book-a-group-flight-with-alaska-airlines/
Published: 2026-09-28

Trips planned with loved ones, which include multiple companions, are quite special and captivating. This can become much easier to plan when done with Alaska Airlines. The major U.S. carrier runs a specialized group travel program that allows passengers to fly together with a number of individuals without any complications. Furthermore, by accessing the Alaska Airlines Group Travel feature, one would be able to secure special rates and added advantages, which elevate the overall flying experience of the individuals. But to obtain these facilities, they have to maintain the rules and regulations first, which can be found in the titles mentioned below. So, read ahead to get familiar with the topic and curate a soothing trip with known faces.

### What Are the Group Booking Terms & Conditions of Alaska Airlines?
Traveling with large parties on Alaska Airlines is convenient and easily accessible for passengers. However, to do that, they are required to meet the minimum requirements of the airline before booking the seats. Furthermore, travelers can easily request a quote by complying with the Alaska Airlines Group Booking terms and conditions. This will also lead them to acquire the discounted rates & privileges that come along with the facility. Additionally, being aware of the guidelines would aid individuals in staying informed and mindful while making decisions about their trip. The following pointers carry detailed information about the guidelines, so refer to them.
- To opt for the group travel feature, the group must contain more than nine passengers.
- The carrier also allows individuals to book tickets 11 months prior to the scheduled departure.
- In place of those flyers who are unable to join on the day of travel, the airline permits substitute travelers.
- Modifications to the individual's names can be made for free up to 72 hours before takeoff.
- Flyers don’t have to pay any deposit to hold the reservations while booking the seats.

### How to Book a Group Flight on Alaska Airlines?
Flying with big groups has become uncomplicated with Alaska Airlines. Similarly, making reservations for the same can also be done efficiently without going through any complications & hassle. This is due to the procedure the carrier provides for making bookings, which is by reaching out to the Alaska Group desk by calling 1-800-445-4435. In this way, one can easily secure the tickets at their own pace and convenience. For more insights about it, check the provided section.
- To begin the reservation procedure, contact the airline by using the above-mentioned phone number.
- Then, transfer the travel details and other requirements over the call with the airline.
- On the basis of the information provided to them, an official quote will be released within two business days.
- Review and accept it within the given timeframe, and proceed with making the payment.
- This can be done by using the available methods mentioned in the quote.
- Afterwards, submit the names of each flyer before the deadline ends and receive the final tickets to the registered email account of the applicant.

### Conclusion
In brief, traveling across destinations with companions is quite pleasant with Alaska Airlines. With the carrier’s group travel feature, it has become swift for flyers to fly within a common schedule. Not only that, but Alaska Group Travel flight bookings can also be made easily by going through the above-mentioned steps. Additionally, the airline offers discounts too, which makes the journey inexpensive for travelers and lets them enjoy the journey without compromising on the benefits & facilities. Thus, it is an ideal way to execute journeys with loved ones.
